source.notes: 냥이네 하숙집, a vertical variety show about cat lodgers (fictional show)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: Variety captions over warm footage: a peach room #FCE3C8 with a wood floor and a cheese cat #F2A04E; captions in yellow #FFC400, pink #FF5C93, sky #3FB6FF, white and red #FF3B3B, each with a two-tone gradient, a white inner stroke and a thick plum #3B1E54 outer stroke; sunbursts for the title cards.
rationale.type: Bagel Fat One for the captions, fat and round so they survive three strokes; Jua for tags; Black Han Sans for sound words.
rationale.motion: Every character of a caption pops on its own spring (0 to 1.15 to 1 in eight frames) one after another; the camera creeps in, punches and shakes; one freeze frame with white concentration lines; captions bob, a ring is drawn round the culprit, confetti falls; vertical 9:16 throughout.
rationale.sound: Bright pop at 128 BPM in G major with a recorded xylophone (VCSL, CC0) on the arpeggios; variety sound words: a flexatone boing, a slapstick and a glass shatter for the crash, pops for the captions, a cowbell for the tag, sparkles for the logo.
rationale.visuals: All code, no footage: the room and the cat (a loaf or sitting, sleeping, open, shocked, looking away or star-eyed, a paw that swipes) are drawn and filmed by a camera transform; captions are three passes per character (outer stroke, white stroke, gradient fill) scaled by a per-character spring.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: the captions are the voice.
